summary: Review A of Phase 3 of track storytime_look_20261107 at b9ba532bffad493c868e1e8ae2dc3e8d8007f044. The import data is correct and the phase scope check passes with look_out_of_scope_paths=0. The source.json shape holds one commit, the full id of 953f798e, and eight files. The received w02 to w07 are leaf-identical to their r3 packages, and the received w01 differs from the r4 package only in the five scripts[].share blocks, which hold 22 leaves. The measured counts are 173 clip entries, 163 distinct keys, and 163 distinct paths, and every path ends in .mp3. The focused runs of the new test, of the contract, readiness, media coverage, and receiver gates, and of the eight edited old-test files all exit 0. The doctor shows only the known Nit line. Review B stays no, with a stated condition, because none of its four trigger conditions holds and the share blocks add no URL, no script, and no external link. Three blocking defects sit in plan.md lines 68 and 69 and in test-strategy.md line 802. Each defect is in an evidence label or a strategy row, not in product code, so Green owns the fix.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] measure/tracks/storytime_look_20261107/plan.md:68: The plan states all 24 differing leaf paths of w01 against the r4 package. The measured count is 22, and the plan's own list in the same note sums to 22 (4 + 4 + 4 + 6 + 4). Rationale: the count label overstates the measured difference, so a reader of the evidence reads a larger change than the data holds. The property the label supports holds, because every differing leaf sits inside scripts[].share, so this is an evidence defect and not a code defect. Fix: change the label 24 to 22 in the plan note.

F2 [Blocker] measure/tracks/storytime_look_20261107/plan.md:69: The plan quotes the label clip_paths_total=163 from the run of look-r3-import.test.ts, and no such label exists in that test. Rationale: case R3 of the test uses the label clip_paths_checked and counts every clip entry, 173 of them, and the distinct path count of 163 is asserted only under the label clip_keys_total of case R4, which counts the distinct keys per week. A checker that parses the test for clip_paths_total finds nothing, so the quoted value proves nothing about the clip paths. The safety property holds, because R3 checks all 173 entries against the safe form and the run exits 0. Fix: quote the labels the test holds, clip_keys_checked=173 and clip_keys_total=163, or add a distinct path label to the test and assert it.

F3 [Blocker] measure/tracks/storytime_look_20261107/test-strategy.md:802 and measure/tracks/storytime_look_20261107/test-strategy.md:764: The closeout gate still requires weeks_equal=7 and clip_paths_checked=163, and the P3.3 row names the label weeks_compared=7 weeks_equal=7. Rationale: the Green evidence at plan.md:68 records weeks_compared=7 weeks_equal=6 under the PM decision of 2026-11-09, because the received w01 differs from the r4 package in the five scripts[].share blocks. The strategy rows were never amended, so the closeout gate of the phase contradicts the recorded evidence and a checker that applies it fails a phase that the PM decision accepted. Fix: amend the two rows to record the PM decision of 2026-11-09 and the label of the receiver resolve command.
nonblocking_findings: measure/tracks/storytime_look_20261107/test-strategy.md:704 (M49) against apps/storytime/lib/contracts/week.ts:114: The K2 rule of the import is ^[a-z]+('[a-z]+)*$ and the contract rule is ^[a-z]+(['-][a-z]+)*$. The K2 rule is the narrower of the two, because it accepts no hyphen separator. No imported key holds a hyphen, so nothing in this phase fails, but a later Workbooks key with a hyphen would parse with the contract and fail the import test. Rationale: a forward-looking note for the next content import, not a defect of this phase.
